Pig

Biography

The village Pig is an unusual conversation subject. Zak addresses it in two short comic exchanges, answered by squeals; one line includes a deliberately humorous “translation”. These scenes provide village colour, rather than evidence that the animal is a humanlike adviser. [1, 2]
